title: "Print School Reports"

```{r}
#| include: false

library(tidyverse)
library(jsonlite)
library(here)

schools  <- read_csv(here("data", "clean", "schools.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
visits   <- read_csv(here("data", "clean", "visits.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)

# Read full update data
raw_full <- read_csv(here("data", "raw", "full_update.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
clean_full <- raw_full |>
  slice(-1) |>
  rename(school_name = Q2) |>
  mutate(school_name = str_trim(school_name))

# Date range defaults: current school year (Aug 1 – Jul 31)
visit_dates <- visits$visit_date[!is.na(visits$visit_date)]
school_year_start <- if (as.integer(format(Sys.Date(), "%m")) >= 8) {
  paste0(format(Sys.Date(), "%Y"), "-08-01")
} else {
  paste0(as.integer(format(Sys.Date(), "%Y")) - 1, "-08-01")
}
date_min <- school_year_start
date_max <- as.character(Sys.Date())

# Build the full data object for all schools
all_school_data <- list()
for (name in sort(schools$school_name)) {
  slug <- name |>
    str_to_lower() |>
    str_replace_all("[^a-z0-9]+", "-") |>
    str_remove("-$")

  school_visits <- visits |> filter(school_name == name) |> mutate(across(everything(), as.character))

  all_school_data[[slug]] <- list(
    info        = schools |> filter(school_name == name) |> as.list(),
    visits      = school_visits,
    full_update = clean_full |> filter(school_name == name) |> mutate(across(everything(), as.character))
  )
}

data_json <- toJSON(all_school_data, auto_unbox = TRUE, na = "null")
```

  <p class="print-instructions">
    Select a date range to filter visit notes, then click <strong>Generate & Print</strong>.<br>
    Each school will appear on its own page. You can print to paper or save as PDF.
  </p>

    <label style="font-weight:600; color:var(--epi-navy); font-size:0.9rem;">Date Range:</label>
    <input type="date" id="print-date-start" value="', date_min, '" style="border:1px solid #ccc; border-radius:4px; padding:0.35rem 0.5rem; font-size:0.85rem;">
    <span style="color:#999;">to</span>
    <input type="date" id="print-date-end" value="', date_max, '" style="border:1px solid #ccc; border-radius:4px; padding:0.35rem 0.5rem; font-size:0.85rem;">
  </div>

  <button class="btn-print" id="btn-generate" onclick="generateReports()">Generate Reports</button>
  <button class="btn-print-now" id="btn-print-now" onclick="window.print()">Print All</button>
  <div id="preview-count"></div>
</div>

<div id="print-area"></div>

var ALL_SCHOOLS = ', data_json, ';

function inRange(dateStr, start, end) {
  if (!dateStr) return false;
  var d = dateStr.slice(0, 10);
  return d >= start && d <= end;
}

/* ── SVG Icons ──────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

  construct:   \'<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><rect x="1" y="6" width="22" height="14" rx="2"/><path d="M1 10h22"/></svg>\',

  school:      \'<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M2 22h20"/><path d="M6 18V7"/><path d="M18 18V7"/><path d="M2 11l10-7 10 7"/></svg>\',

  graduation:  \'<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M22 10l-10-5L2 10l10 5 10-5z"/><path d="M6 12v5c0 2 3 3 6 3s6-1 6-3v-5"/></svg>\'
};

var PROGRAM_CFG = {
  "MGR":                   { label: "MGR / Lanterns",    icon: "lantern",   color: "#F5B800" },
  "Non-Generating MGR":    { label: "Non-Gen MGR",       icon: "mgr_ng",    color: "#e67e22" },
  "Library":               { label: "Library",           icon: "library",   color: "#3498db" },
  "Computer":              { label: "Computers",         icon: "computer",  color: "#9b59b6" },
  "Feminine Hygiene Kits": { label: "Menstrual Kits",    icon: "kit",       color: "#e91e63" },
  "Science Kits":          { label: "Science Kits",      icon: "science",   color: "#28a745" },
  "Construction Projects": { label: "Construction",      icon: "construct", color: "#795548" },
  "Boreholes":             { label: "Boreholes",         icon: "water",     color: "#00bcd4" },
  "Solar Power":           { label: "Solar Power",       icon: "solar",     color: "#ff9800" },
  "Biofill Toilets":       { label: "Biofill Toilets",   icon: "toilet",    color: "#607d8b" },
  "Light a Village":       { label: "Light a Village",   icon: "bulb",      color: "#ffc107" }
};

function buildSchoolReport(slug, data, start, end) {
  var info = data.info;

  var allVisits = data.visits || [];
  var visits = allVisits;
  if (start && end && Array.isArray(allVisits)) {
    visits = allVisits.filter(function(v) {
      return inRange(v.visit_date || v.StartDate || "", start, end);
    });
  }

  var html = \'<div class="school-report">\';

  /* ── Header banner ──────────────────────────────────────────── */
  html += \'<div class="rpt-header">\';
  html += \'<img src="images/epi-logo.png" alt="EPI">\';
  html += \'<div>\';
  html += \'<h2>\' + info.school_name + \'</h2>\';
  var subtitle = [];
  if (info.Region) subtitle.push(info.Region + " Region");
  if (info["EPI Start Year"]) subtitle.push("Partner Since " + info["EPI Start Year"]);
  html += \'<div class="rpt-subtitle">\' + subtitle.join("  &bull;  ") + \'</div>\';
  html += \'</div></div>\';

  /* ── Stat cards ─────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  var fu = data.full_update;
  var latest = (Array.isArray(fu) && fu.length > 0) ? fu[fu.length - 1] : null;

  html += \'<div class="rpt-stats">\';
  if (latest && latest.Q6) {
    html += \'<div class="rpt-stat"><div class="rpt-stat-icon">\' + ICONS.school + \'</div>\';
    html += \'<div class="rpt-stat-value">\' + parseInt(latest.Q6).toLocaleString() + \'</div>\';
    html += \'<div class="rpt-stat-label">Students</div></div>\';
  }
  if (latest && latest.Q7) {
    html += \'<div class="rpt-stat"><div class="rpt-stat-icon">\' + ICONS.teacher + \'</div>\';
    html += \'<div class="rpt-stat-value">\' + latest.Q7 + \'</div>\';
    html += \'<div class="rpt-stat-label">Teachers</div></div>\';
  }
  if (latest && latest.Q5) {
    html += \'<div class="rpt-stat"><div class="rpt-stat-icon">\' + ICONS.people + \'</div>\';
    html += \'<div class="rpt-stat-value">\' + parseInt(latest.Q5).toLocaleString() + \'</div>\';
    html += \'<div class="rpt-stat-label">Community Pop.</div></div>\';
  }
  html += \'<div class="rpt-stat"><div class="rpt-stat-icon">\' + ICONS.clipboard + \'</div>\';
  html += \'<div class="rpt-stat-value">\' + visits.length + \'</div>\';
  html += \'<div class="rpt-stat-label">Visits in Range</div></div>\';
  html += \'</div>\';

  /* ── Program badges with icons ──────────────────────────────── */
  var progs = Object.keys(PROGRAM_CFG).filter(function(k) { return info[k] == 1; });
  if (progs.length > 0) {
    html += \'<div class="rpt-programs">\';
    progs.forEach(function(k) {
      var cfg = PROGRAM_CFG[k];
      html += \'<span class="rpt-prog-badge" style="border-left:3pt solid \' + cfg.color + \';">\';
      html += ICONS[cfg.icon] + " " + cfg.label + \'</span>\';
    });
    html += \'</div>\';
  }

  /* ── Enrollment bar + Academic stats ────────────────────────── */
  if (latest) {
    var primaryN = latest.Q8 ? parseInt(latest.Q8) : 0;
    var jhsN = (latest.Q11 && latest.Q11 !== "null") ? parseInt(latest.Q11) : 0;
    if (isNaN(jhsN)) jhsN = 0;
    var total = primaryN + jhsN;

    var hasAcademics = latest.Q9 || latest.Q12 || latest.Q13 || (latest.Q15 && latest.Q15 !== "N/A");

    if (total > 0 || hasAcademics) {
      html += \'<div class="rpt-columns">\';

      // Left column: enrollment
      html += \'<div class="rpt-col">\';
      if (total > 0) {
        html += \'<div class="rpt-section">\' + ICONS.graduation + \' Enrollment Breakdown</div>\';
        var pPct = Math.round(primaryN / total * 100);
        var jPct = 100 - pPct;
        html += \'<div class="rpt-enroll-bar">\';
        if (primaryN > 0) html += \'<div class="rpt-bar-primary" style="width:\' + pPct + \'%">Primary \' + primaryN + \'</div>\';
        if (jhsN > 0) html += \'<div class="rpt-bar-jhs" style="width:\' + jPct + \'%">JHS \' + jhsN + \'</div>\';
        html += \'</div>\';
        html += \'<div class="rpt-enroll-legend">Total: \' + total.toLocaleString() + \' students</div>\';
      }
      html += \'</div>\';

      // Right column: academic outcomes
      html += \'<div class="rpt-col">\';
      if (hasAcademics) {
        html += \'<div class="rpt-section">\' + ICONS.graduation + \' Last Year Outcomes</div>\';
        html += \'<table class="rpt-table">\';
        if (latest.Q9) html += \'<tr><td>Primary to JHS</td><td>\' + latest.Q9 + \' students</td></tr>\';
        if (latest.Q12) html += \'<tr><td>BECE Test Takers</td><td>\' + latest.Q12 + \'</td></tr>\';
        if (latest.Q13) html += \'<tr><td>BECE Passers</td><td>\' + latest.Q13 + \'</td></tr>\';
        if (latest.Q15 && latest.Q15 !== "N/A") html += \'<tr><td>To Secondary/Technical</td><td>\' + latest.Q15 + \' students</td></tr>\';
        html += \'</table>\';
      }
      html += \'</div>\';

      html += \'</div>\'; // end columns
    }
  }

  /* ── Visit Notes ────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  html += \'<div class="rpt-section">\' + ICONS.calendar + \' Visit Notes &mdash; \' + start + \' to \' + end + \'</div>\';
  if (visits.length > 0) {
    var sorted = visits.slice().sort(function(a, b) {
      return (b.visit_date || "").localeCompare(a.visit_date || "");
    });
    sorted.forEach(function(v) {
      html += \'<div class="rpt-visit">\';
      html += \'<div class="rpt-visit-header">\';
      html += \'<span class="rpt-visit-date">\' + (v.visit_date || "No date") + \'</span>\';
      if (v.visitor) html += \'<span class="rpt-visit-staff">Staff: \' + v.visitor + \'</span>\';
      html += \'</div>\';
      if (v.visit_reason) html += \'<p><span class="rpt-field-label">Reason:</span> \' + v.visit_reason + \'</p>\';
      if (v.activities) html += \'<p><span class="rpt-field-label">Activities:</span> \' + v.activities + \'</p>\';
      if (v.doing_well) html += \'<p><span class="rpt-field-label">Doing well:</span> \' + v.doing_well + \'</p>\';
      if (v.struggles) html += \'<p><span class="rpt-field-label">Struggles:</span> \' + v.struggles + \'</p>\';
      if (v.urgent_issues && v.urgent_issues.toLowerCase() !== "no" && v.urgent_issues.toLowerCase() !== "none" && v.urgent_issues.toLowerCase() !== "n/a") {
        html += \'<p><span class="rpt-urgent">Urgent:</span> \' + v.urgent_issues + \'</p>\';
      }
      if (v.observations) html += \'<p><span class="rpt-field-label">Observations:</span> \' + v.observations + \'</p>\';
      html += \'</div>\';
    });
  } else {
    html += \'<p class="rpt-no-data">No visits recorded in this date range.</p>\';
  }

  /* ── Footer ─────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  html += \'<div class="rpt-footer">Empower Playgrounds Inc. &bull; School Profile Report &bull; Generated \' + new Date().toLocaleDateString() + \'</div>\';

  html += \'</div>\';
  return html;
}

function generateReports() {
  var start = document.getElementById("print-date-start").value;
  var end = document.getElementById("print-date-end").value;
  var btn = document.getElementById("btn-generate");
  btn.disabled = true;
  btn.textContent = "Generating...";

  setTimeout(function() {
    var slugs = Object.keys(ALL_SCHOOLS).sort();
    var allHtml = "";
    var count = 0;

    slugs.forEach(function(slug) {
      allHtml += buildSchoolReport(slug, ALL_SCHOOLS[slug], start, end);
      count++;
    });

    var printArea = document.getElementById("print-area");
    printArea.innerHTML = allHtml;
    printArea.classList.add("generated");

    document.getElementById("preview-count").textContent = count + " school reports generated. Scroll down to preview, or click Print All.";
    document.getElementById("btn-print-now").style.display = "inline-block";

    btn.disabled = false;
    btn.textContent = "Generate Reports";
  }, 100);
}
</script>
'))
